_comment: experiment_v6 — signal-enhanced market making. VIP 0 fee: maker 0.02%, taker 0.055%.
_comment_lev: Leverage: 5x for BTC/ETH (liquid, tight spreads), 3x default for others. use_cross_margin=true shares account balance as collateral.
_comment_pos: Native TP/SL via set_trading_stop on fill. max_hold_min = backup market close.
_comment_tp_fees: tp_cover_round_trip_fees: TP distance is max(tp_pct, fee_floor). fee_floor = 2×maker(0.02%) + buffer if tp_exit_assume_taker=false; else maker+taker. Set tp_pct small (e.g. 0.0005) and enable cover to 'take profit just above fees'. SL unchanged.
_comment_alert: periodic_alert_min: rolling PnL+fee Telegram alert interval. daily_report_hkt_hour: 22 = 10 PM HKT.
_comment_symbols: Bybit linear symbols for WS + MM. File next to this folder; override path via symbols_csv.
_backtest_note: based on backtest net_pnl=+42.8854 sharpe=67.970 symbol=ETHUSDT
